04/15.05.2024 Heard the Parties.

Petitioner has been made an accused in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No. 62/2023,
Corresponding to Pocso Case No. 24/2024, registered under Sections 376(3)/ 342/ 341/ 417/34 of
the Indian Penal Code, Sections 04/ 06 of the Pocso Act and charge has been framed under
sections 417/ 376(3) of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4 (2)/ 06 of the Pocso Act, pending in
the Court of learned A.J.C.-Iv, Ranchi.
The petitioner is said to have enticed away the victim and took her to an isolated place and raped her.
The victim is a minor girl aged about 15 years.
Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case; I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Accordingly, his prayer for bail is hereby rejected.
